## What's new in plus-14

### Rebased on upstream `v1.1.0` (5 Nov 2026)
- Artists page can show artists or album artists
  ([#2127](https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2127)); the alphabet bar of this fork
  hides empty letters for both
- Video playback requests audio focus, so background music pauses
  ([#2151](https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2151))
- Play/pause from untrusted media controllers
  ([#2145](https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2145))
- HDHomeRun Live TV direct playback fixed
  ([#2163](https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2163)), adding a Seerr server without the
  plugin fixed ([#2179](https://github.com/damontecres/Wholphin/pull/2179))
- Updated translations, including Russian

Upstream notes that `v1.1.0` is the last release to support Jellyfin 10.10 and 10.11.

Everything else from plus-13 is still included. The full list of differences from upstream is in the
[README](https://github.com/SergeiAK/Wholphin-plus#what-is-different-from-upstream).
